what_it_does: This paper introduces PEZY-SC4s, a fourth-generation processor containing hundreds of identical CPU cores designed to run both traditional high-performance computing (HPC) workloads and modern AI tasks like model training and inference. The chip prioritizes energy efficiency—burning as little power as possible while running billions of operations per second—by tightly coupling a large number of simple, uniform cores with fast pathways to memory and a flexible network connecting the cores. Unlike specialized accelerators designed for one type of task, this architecture balances the demands of both scientific simulation and AI to offer good performance across both domains.
